summary: Identify strict kit-play browser contexts as Storybook's test runner so each case pauses animations for the a11y check instead of sleeping a fixed 100 ms, and make the sidebar row play await the hover card it leaves open.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. CI kit plays keep fresh pages, cleared storage, the full story and viewport/theme matrix and every strict and a11y assertion; per-case a11y results were compared case by case with and without the change.
